verifications.claim: As of March 2026, the current public version of iOS is iOS 26.3.1.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'If you are up-to-date — 26.3.1 for iPhones and iPads, as of March 19'; R6: 'iOS 26.3.1 ... 04 Mar 2026' and 'Background Security Improvements for ... iOS 26.3.1 ... 17 Mar 2026' (prior to iOS 26.4 on 24 Mar)
verifications.reasoning: R5 directly states 26.3.1 is the up-to-date public version as of March 19, 2026; R6 confirms release timeline with no public 26.4 until after March 19.

verifications.claim: As of March 2026, iOS 26.4 is in the Release Candidate stage.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Apple provided developers and public beta testers with the release candidate versions of iOS 26.4 ... Wednesday March 18, 2026'; R6: 'iOS 26.4 ... 24 Mar 2026'
verifications.reasoning: R2 explicitly states RC stage on March 18, 2026; R6 lists full release later on March 24.

verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Apple Music- Playlist Playground (beta) generates a playlist from your description...'; listed as first feature in iOS 26.4 release notes
verifications.reasoning: Playlist Playground is a prominently listed new feature in iOS 26.4 notes, but 'focuses on' is not directly stated amid other features.

verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No reference mentions iOS 26.4 focusing on or emphasizing enhanced security; security updates referenced for 26.3.1.

verifications.claim: IOS 26.4 focuses on a "Liquid Glass" design overhaul.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3: 'A new design with Liquid Glass ... on iOS 26'; R2: 'Reduce Motion setting more reliably reduces the animations of Liquid Glass' (accessibility tweak in 26.4)
verifications.reasoning: Liquid Glass is a design update for iOS 26 overall (R3), not a focus or overhaul in 26.4; R2 only mentions minor accessibility adjustment.

verifications.claim: IOS 26.3.1 is designed for iPhone 11 and later
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'iOS 26.3.1 ... iPhone 11 and later'; R2: 'update your iPhone 11 or newer to iOS 26.4'
verifications.reasoning: R6 directly states compatibility as 'iPhone 11 and later' for iOS 26.3.1; R2 confirms for iOS 26 series.
